title: Matter registry index
description: The index @lovo/matter-cli reads to copy Tier 1 components into a user's project.

version.description: Registry format version, independent of the package versions.

components.description: Component slug to entry. The slug is what a user passes to `matter add`.

sourcePath.description: A .ts or .tsx path relative to the registry root. Must stay inside it: the CLI writes these into a user's project, and refuses any path that resolves outside the configured components directory.

file.description: Entry point, relative to the registry root: the wrapper the user imports.

files.description: Every other source the component needs, relative to the registry root: its shader, plus any shared helper under utils/. The CLI leaves relative import specifiers alone, so anything a listed file imports must itself be listed or the install will not compile.

dependencies.description: npm packages the component needs. Printed as an install hint after `matter add`.

uses_primitives.description: Tier 2 primitives the component builds on. Documentation only; the CLI does not read it.
